$Comment: The capstone over both campaign achievements. MetaChildren is what makes it one: it has no
criteria of its own and earns itself the moment every achievement it names is earned, so
adding a third campaign here is the only edit a third zone needs.
ServerFirst makes it a race only one player on the server can win. Everybody else keeps their
progress and is told, once, that they were beaten, and Announce is the broadcast the winner
sets off - which is why it is safe here and would be noise on an achievement everyone earns.
The payout waits in the achievements menu to be collected.
Enabled is false: one of its two MetaChildren, howling_sands_campaign, is disabled too, so this
capstone could never be earned. Flip all three back on together once the desert campaign ships.
